[[AS Saint-Etienne]] won '''Division 1 season 1969/1970''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 56 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1970/1971|Division 1 season 1970/1971]]
* [[OGC Nice]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
* [[AS Nancy]]: runner-up of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
* [[Stade de Reims]]: 4th place in [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], but [[Olympique Avignonnais]] (3rd) was not financially strong enough to play in [[Ligue 1|Division 1]]
